description.text: Main Courses: Advanced Chinese Language, Advanced Oral Chinese, Advanced Chinese Listening, Chinese culture, medium Chinese writing, HSK training (Preliminary/Medium/Advanced) Descriptions: HSK Band 4 is a precondition. Students will improve Chinese Language proficiency by practice. Students could pass HSK Band 8 after learning. Average number of Students: about 7 Study Duration: half year or one year Tuition: RMB 6500 for one semester; and RMB 13000 for one year

duration.text: The Advanced Chinese Training Courses at Hunan University Of Technology and Business is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 902 USD/per semester ￥ 6500 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: Applicants should be 18-60 years old with good health
